provenance.description: Caledonia Township parcel addresses, each matched to its voting precinct. Generated, not edited by hand.
provenance.format: street -> [[house number, index into `precincts`, metres from the precinct edge (capped at 60)], ...]. A fourth element, when present, lists every precinct the address touches: it straddles a line and the answer is genuinely ambiguous.
provenance.licence: Public record of Kent County, redistributed as published.
provenance.how_to_update: Run refresh_addresses.py. Re-run it after refresh_precincts.py, since the precinct a parcel falls in is baked in here.
provenance.deliberately_omitted: Owner names, parcel ids and valuations are read from the source and discarded. This file is served to browsers.
